first_page_title_excerpt:
R E L AT I V I S T I C F L U I D DY N A M I C S I N A N D O U T
                          OF EQUILIBRIUM




The past decade has seen unprecedented developments in the understanding
of relativistic ﬂuid dynamics in and out of equilibrium, with connections to
astrophysics, cosmology, string theory, quantum information, nuclear physics,
and condensed matter physics. Romatschke and Romatschke oﬀer a powerful
new framework for ﬂuid dynamics, exploring its connections to kinetic theory,
gauge/gravity duality, and thermal quantum ﬁeld theory. Numerical algorithms
to solve the equations of motion of relativistic dissipative ﬂuid dynamics as
well as applications to various systems are discussed.
